messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego on 2026-06-17. [decision; valid 2026-06-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-17]
- Page Tomasz for anything this cycle for Team Dune, not Farah, as of 2026-06-03. [decision; valid 2026-06-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-03]
    earlier: Page Farah for anything this cycle for Team Dune, not Tomasz, as of 2026-04-09. [decision; valid 2026-04-09 to 2026-06-03; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-09]
    earlier: Page Tomasz for anything this cycle for Team Dune, not Farah, as of 2026-02-24. [decision; valid 2026-02-24 to 2026-04-09; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-24]
    earlier: Farah is on call for Team Dune this cycle as of 2026-01-22, not Tomasz. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to 2026-02-24; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-22]
    earlier: Tomasz is on call for Team Dune this cycle as of 2026-01-14. [valid 2026-01-14 to 2026-01-22; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-14]
- As of 2026-05-28, Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-28]
- Diego has the Ember pager as of the 2026-05-13 cycle, taking over from Oskar. [decision; valid 2026-05-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-13]
    earlier: Oskar has the Ember pager as of the 2026-03-16 cycle, taking over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-16 to 2026-05-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
    earlier: Diego carries the Team Ember on-call phone as of the 2026-01-23 on-call swap, until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-23 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-23]
    earlier: Oskar is on call for team Ember this cycle. [valid 2025-05-28 to 2026-01-23; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-28]
- Boreal decided at standup on 2026-05-05 that the event bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-05]
- Boreal has a weekly dependency update day as of 2026-05-04. [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- On 2026-05-01, the Cinder team observed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
- The webhook dispatcher moved from Team Atlas to Team Dune on 2026-04-22. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-04-22, after Team Atlas kept it until then. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- The indexer moved from Team Dune to Boreal as of 2026-04-22. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
- The flags service is Team Atlas's service as of 2026-04-21, after moving from Team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is Team Dune's service as of 2026-01-29, after moving from Cinder. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to 2026-04-21; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-18 to 2026-01-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
